auth.welcomeBody: Sign in for a fast view of regional prices, transactions, and property value estimates.
auth.highlightPrepared: Automatic ETN preparation turns raw uploads into a ready-to-train dataset.
auth.highlightModel: Model status, source dataset, and training readiness are visible in one place.
auth.highlightInsights: Predictions, diagnostics, and regional insights stay inside the same workspace.

layout.workflowHint: Admins can upload, prepare, and train. Viewers can explore predictions and market insight.
layout.adminWorkbenchBody: This area remains reserved for admins who handle ETN uploads, training-data preparation, model training, diagnostics, and user access.
layout.profileDescription: Change your display name and optional avatar URL to make the workspace feel more personal.
layout.avatarHint: Use an HTTPS image URL, a local path, or a data URL. Leave blank to use initials.

short.prepare: Turn ETN files into training data

page.default: Keep the data pipeline, model status, and prediction tools in sync from one place.
page.login: Sign in to manage uploads, preparation, model training, and prediction workflows.
page.dashboard: A concise view of the Slovenian property market with municipalities, regions, and recent sales.
page.data: Upload raw sources, inspect datasets, and confirm the prepared training file is ready.
page.prepare: Detect ETN pairs, generate `train.csv`, and hand the result directly to the model workflow.
page.model: Choose the prepared dataset, start training, and track the latest model source.
page.prediction: Use the trained model to estimate prices and review recent prediction history.
page.map: Browse transaction density, pricing ranges, and regional behavior across Slovenia.
page.diagnostics: Inspect global metrics, per-type metrics, and model health in detail.
page.analysis: Compare listing prices with model expectations to spot under- and over-priced inventory.
page.admin: Control users, roles, and platform usage from the admin console.
page.adminHome: Admin gateway for data uploads, preparation, model work, diagnostics, and user management.
page.adminUsers: Manage users, roles, and access for companies and internal teams.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.consumerTitle: Quickly gauge how the Slovenian property market is moving
dashboard.consumerBody: Regular users get a compact snapshot of municipalities, regions, price per m², and recent sales before moving into valuation, map, or listing analysis.
dashboard.marketCommandTitle: Analytical control room for the Slovenian ETN market
dashboard.marketCommandBody: See municipality activity, price leaders, latest sales, and model readiness together before moving into map, valuation, or training flows.
dashboard.filterCompareHint: The selector below acts as a comparison lens, not a way to hide the rest of the market.
dashboard.segmentTopMarketsTitle: Where the selected type is most active right now
dashboard.filterAllHint: Switch between the whole market and the same dashboard constrained to a single property type.
dashboard.filterActive: This analytical view is currently scoped to: {type}.
dashboard.quickPredictionDesc: Run a new price estimate immediately.
dashboard.quickMapDesc: See where pricing density and transaction counts are shifting.
dashboard.quickPrepareDesc: Generate or refresh the prepared `train.csv` dataset.
dashboard.quickTrainDesc: Launch training from the recommended prepared dataset.
dashboard.preparedMissingDetail: Go to Data Preparation and generate `raw/train.csv` first.
dashboard.modelMissingDetail: Train the prepared dataset to unlock predictions and diagnostics.
dashboard.workflowAdminDetail: Keep the prepared dataset and current model source aligned before reviewing insights.
dashboard.workflowViewerDetail: Use predictions, map views, and analysis without touching the training pipeline.

data.workspaceBody: Manage uploads, inspect the prepared training dataset, and surface unresolved municipalities or alias collisions before they leak into the consumer market app.
data.uploadHint: CSV and ZIP uploads are stored once, deduplicated, and made available to the preparation workflow.
data.datasetLibraryHint: Each file remains available for preview, preparation, and model-source traceability.
data.referenceCoverageHint: Official municipality reference versus currently covered municipalities in the training dataset.
data.qualityHint: Rows without a canonical municipality stay in admin diagnostics instead of viewer metrics.
data.unresolvedHint: These raw values should be cleaned or mapped correctly before they appear in market analysis.
data.aliasHint: Multiple raw labels map to the same canonical municipality. This is useful for cleaning ETN inputs.
data.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this dataset?
data.confirmDeleteAll: Are you sure you want to delete ALL datasets?

model.trainingTitle: Train from the prepared dataset, not from guesswork.
model.trainingBody: The Model view now highlights the prepared training file first, shows where the current model came from, and makes the live training run and completed history easy to inspect.
model.prepareDataFirst: Go to Data Preparation to generate `raw/train.csv`.
model.selectSourceHint: Use the prepared dataset whenever possible. Other uploaded CSVs remain available as manual sources.
model.trainingLockedHint: A training run is already active. Wait for it to finish before starting another one.
model.trainingCtaHint: Only one training run is allowed at a time. Pick a source and start a new job when the system is idle.
model.trainingHistoryHint: Recent jobs stay visible after completion, so you can quickly inspect progress, failures, and duration.
model.noTrainingHistory: No training jobs have been recorded yet for this model.
model.propertyTypeBreakdownHint: Compare the quality of the global and per-type models for each trained segment.
model.featureImportanceHint: Inputs with the strongest effect on the current price estimates.
model.completedRunsHint: Every completed run stores its source, metrics, and duration for later comparison.
model.noModel: No model trained yet. Upload data and start training.

predict.title: Property Price Prediction
predict.avmBody: Describe the property first, then review the estimate beside municipality context and ranked comparable transactions.
predict.valuationBody: Model output, municipality backdrop, and comparable sales stay visible in a single working column.
predict.noComparables: Not enough comparable transactions were found for this profile.
predict.emptyState: Run a prediction and this column will assemble the valuation story.
predict.noHistory: No saved predictions yet for this user.
predict.coordsAutoHint: Coordinates are inferred from the selected municipality when needed.
predict.pickMunicipalityHint: Pick a municipality and the app will use local context plus approximate coordinates.

map.title: Market map
map.explorerBody: Default to individual transactions, keep the legend visible, and make it easy to jump into a municipality or a prefilled valuation flow.
map.filterHint: The legend stays visible at all times, and each price band can be clicked to filter the map instantly.
map.drawerHint: Click a transaction to open full details, municipality access, and a prefilled AVM scenario.
map.overviewHint: Click a municipality to open its activity summary, price levels, and next-step actions.
map.regionSnapshotHint: A quick read on where the most activity is happening and how price levels differ by region.
map.municipalitySummaryHint: For municipality context, open the municipality page or keep exploring with filters.
map.noPreparedData: A prepared ETN dataset for the map is not available yet. An admin needs to run data preparation first.
map.noCoordinates: The selected data does not contain enough coordinates to render the map right now.
map.noMatches: No transactions matched the current filters.

municipality.pageDescription: Detailed municipality view with trend, type mix, recent transactions, and related markets in the same region.
municipality.heroBody: Current municipality snapshot for region {region}, with enough context to compare, jump to the map, or seed a valuation scenario.
